description.en: Nordenskioldia-inspired preserved fruiting axis organ only: a slender axis carries four separated radial segmented fruits on persistent receptacles, with visible wedge-shaped fruitlet boundaries. Ten fruitlets per teaching fruit are an artistic simplification, not the source specimens counted thirteen/fifteen. No separate seed asset, unknown whole tree, flowers or leafy crown.
description.zh: Nordenskioldia启发保存果序轴器官：细轴带四个分隔清楚的放射分段果，接入宿存果托，小楔形果片边界可读。每果十片是教学简化，不冒称原标本十三/十五片计数；不另计种子，不造未知整树、花或叶冠。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
